hardRule: Tribute cannot buy Power, Attack, Defense, combat Crew, PvP advantage, or unlimited Energy that converts to Power.

rejectedItems.name: Contract Muscle
rejectedItems.reason: Permanent Crew can improve combat power and help a paying player beat a free player in PvP.

rejectedItems.name: Energy Drop
rejectedItems.reason: Energy converts into jobs, cash, XP, district control, and long-term power.

rejectedItems.name: Shadow Crate
rejectedItems.oldEffect: Random cash, energy, stamina, or full heal
rejectedItems.reason: Random rewards can create paid combat advantage through stamina, healing, cash, or energy.

items.name: Custom HQ Skin: Warehouse Front
items.description: Changes the look of your boss HQ to a dark warehouse-front operation.

items.name: Profile Background: Southside Concrete
items.description: Adds a Southside concrete-pour background to your boss profile.

items.name: Construction Banner Pack
items.description: Unlocks concrete, warehouse, caution-stripe, and blueprint-style profile banners.

items.name: Blueprint UI Theme
items.description: Applies an exclusive blueprint-style UI theme. Pure visual upgrade.

items.name: Gold Concrete Nameplate
items.description: Adds a gold concrete-style nameplate to your boss profile and Reputation Wall posts.

items.name: Extra Saved Look Slot
items.description: Adds one extra saved cosmetic/loadout look slot. Does not affect combat or income.

items.name: Foreman Pass
items.description: 30-day convenience pass with one non-combat crew assignment slot, 2x offline income storage cap, and the exclusive Blueprint UI theme.
items.fairPlayNotes: The extra crew slot must never count toward PvP attack, PvP defense, or combat power. It can only be used for non-combat assignments such as managers, lookouts, cosmetics, or offline collection storage.

items.name: Back in Business Bundle
items.description: For returning players only. If offline 7+ days, claim 1,000 Cash and 50 Recovery Energy once per month.
items.fairPlayNotes: This is a controlled churn-recovery offer, not an unlimited power purchase. Recovery Energy should not apply to PvP, Turf War scoring, or repeatable power farming.
